species.tagline: A gentle green snake of Hong Kong's woodlands

tasks.title: Find the head
tasks.message: The greater green snake has a round head, not a pointed one.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a greater green snake. Its head is round and its eyes are big.

tasks.title: Find the tongue
tasks.message: A snake's tongue is forked — it uses it to smell.
tasks.subtitle: Snakes do not smell with a nose. They flick out their tongue to smell around.

tasks.title: See the real snake
tasks.hint: Tap "Real photo" and drag the slider
tasks.message: A real greater green snake is bright green all over.
tasks.subtitle: This is a photo of a real greater green snake. Drag the slider to compare.

tasks.title: What to do
tasks.message: If you see a snake, do not touch it and do not shout — walk away quietly.
tasks.subtitle: Greater green snakes are harmless and will not attack. Just walk away quietly. Thank you!
